doom.name: Doom-like brown ramp + 216 colors
doom.description: First 48 entries brown gradient + 6x6x6 cube + grayscale tail

quantization.note: LUT encodes RGB 32^3 -> nearest palette index via brute search in palette.js

docs.paletteStyle: Enum for palette generation style — doom (brown ramp + cube), smooth256 (cube + gray), truecolor (bypass), grayscale, sepia
docs.authentic: When true, enable retro palette quantization + banding
docs.bandLevels: Number of color bands for authentic mode — lower = more retro
docs.brownRamp.from: Start color of brown ramp (doom style) as [R,G,B] — tweak to adjust warm tones
docs.brownRamp.to: End color of brown ramp (doom style) as [R,G,B]
docs.brownRamp.count: How many entries in palette are brown ramp (0-216) — default 48 for doom
docs.cubeLevels: 6 levels for 6x6x6 color cube (0-255 each) — tweak for custom cube
docs.customColors: Per-index overrides as map { "0": [R,G,B], ... } — click swatch in editor to tweak

paletteStyle.desc: Chooses how the 256-color palette is generated
